payload.claim: DESIGN.md §5.5 (the document specs cite by stable section number) still asserts, uncorrected by this diff, that "lens #3 in a naive design would be 'test quality' — but the `revert` gate now answers that mechanically and for free," and two lines above it (889–893) still lists the third lens as blast radius, gated at `elevated` only. This change ships exactly the lens that passage says was rejected — a prompted test-quality/adequacy critic, running at every tier, with `revert` still unbuilt — and none of the nine changed files touch DESIGN.md, so the authoritative design contract now actively contradicts the shipped mechanism it describes rather than merely lagging it. No gate checks DESIGN.md against `review.LENSES`, so this is invisible to the suite.
